reviewer: /root, refreshed source-bound statistics and reconstruction review; existing audited examples retained unchanged

findings.title: 47 settings cover all four complete task banks
findings.detail: The source-checked snapshot contains 235 of 280 complete method–task evaluations. All 70 settings remain in the comparison; every completed task uses its full original question grid.

findings.title: Better reconstruction is clearer than better explanations
findings.detail: Reconstruction has 249 defined task means, including 221 fully comparable rows. Best-of-32 and pooling improve fit in every task, while audited concept hits can still contain wrong names, equations or role details.

findings.title: Shortening trades information for simplicity
findings.detail: Deleting or filtering text can remove unsupported details and clarify extraction. It can also remove every useful reading site for a question.

selection.finding: Additional samples sometimes recover missing names or a clearer direction of action. Selected arithmetic hits can still describe the wrong calculation, and other useful details are lost.
selection.limits: These are illustrative cases, not an estimate of how often the changes occur. Complete sampling curves remain the quantitative comparison.

consensus.finding: Semantic agreement can remove an incorrect specific detail, such as a DETR variant name, while retaining the useful topic. Stricter filtering can also keep a final-answer fragment and discard the only required intermediate name.
consensus.limits: Repeated does not mean correct. Some numerical improvements come from emphasizing a number already present, rather than adding a faithful explanation.

pruning.finding: Pruning sometimes removes a wrong entity or peripheral assertion, but sometimes deletes the only useful name or action-bearing bullet. Some official verdict improvements reclassify an unchanged retained statement; those are marked as judge sensitivity.
pruning.limits: Separate parent comparisons are audited. A lower reconstruction contribution does not establish that a bullet is false; shorter text can change the judge's extraction.

pooling.finding: Pooling improves reconstruction by combining complementary original bullets. Some required names or relations are recovered, but the selected set can still contain incompatible collaborators, role directions or calculations.
pooling.limits: A correct recovered concept does not make the combined explanation coherent. The natural output lengths are retained in the comparison.

verification.finding: Comparing activation scores changes which descriptions are selected. The audited examples still include incorrect surrounding names and equations, even when the required concept is recovered.
verification.limits: The retained likelihood example audit covers arithmetic. Other completed quantitative task results are shown separately; these scores are evidence signals, not truth checks.

editing.finding: The first-round proposals have been generated. Their reconstruction scoring and final benchmark evaluation are still running.
editing.limits: No expanded editing result is claimed in this snapshot. New wording needs its own reconstruction vectors and separate evaluation.

combinations.finding: Several combinations inherit their parent readout exactly at an audited site. Other filters genuinely delete useful bridge or action content. Parent comparisons separate the added component from gains already obtained by sampling or pooling.
combinations.limits: Actual-parent audits separate the added component from sampling or pooling. Expanded editing combinations are still pending; no setting is dropped for a weak pilot result.

raw_n1-n1.finding: Anchors preserve raw baseline contents: wrong chemical identity, named DETR variant, absent required bridge, final answer rather than intermediate, and early generic summary instructions. Extra raw bullets can change ranked-number endpoints without correcting arithmetic. The classroom win is whitespace-only and requires caution; the idiom regression flags claims already retained in the baseline.
raw_n1-n1.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

best_n_exact-n2.finding: More candidate choice recovers Simula67 and Enkidu bridge strings and a clear toddler-to-babysitter relation, while solubility anchors still substitute other chemicals. Win prose often retains incorrect proper names or incidental details. Role and chain regressions can arise from conflicting bullets or changed extraction ranking rather than uniformly worse content.
best_n_exact-n2.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

best_n_exact-n16.finding: The DETR anchor removes the named variant flagged in baseline but leaves causal mechanism language; chemical anchor remains a different substance. Clear reverse-feeding role recovery is stronger evidence than chain wins naming the right numeral as a final answer. The comedian anchor loses explicit scathing/witty comeback wording and official action recovery, despite keeping comedian-to-heckler direction.
best_n_exact-n16.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

random_complete-n32.finding: Larger-pool random selection also yields bridge and feeding wins, so these examples do not establish that FVE ranking is the cause of recovery. It can replace correct bridge strings with unrelated titles or generic summaries. Its critic/musician win contains a returned-choice/rationale inconsistency, documented separately.
random_complete-n32.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

prune_loo_a32_0.001-n32.finding: The two hallucination anchors still substitute a wrong substance, but the DETR output replaces the flagged named variant with a named deformable-attention variant and scores consistent. Bridge wins and reversals largely track surviving names, not globally faithful explanations. The reverse-feeding example removes contradictory babysitter-to-toddler prose; early accountant/waiter anchors remain generic summaries. A retained AI self-description becomes flagged in a pruning regression.
prune_loo_a32_0.001-n32.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

random_delete_matched_a32_0.005-n32.finding: Deletion preserves bridge wins but drops Coyolxauhqui while retaining final-answer Huitzilopochtli. The role feeding win is the same directional evidence as the LOO-pruning case; the comedian anchor loses explicit comeback wording. A chain regression still prints the intermediate5 in an explanation but ranks other arithmetic values first; this is top1 recovery sensitivity.
random_delete_matched_a32_0.005-n32.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

best_n_specificity_mean-n32.finding: Anchors mix genuine bridge-name recovery with erroneous coparticipant names; one full output includes both a correct named pair and wrong alternatives. Reverse-feeding role recovery is clear, whereas early role outputs are generic summaries. Chain apparent win75 is tied to the explicitly incorrect equality ceil(45/2)=75, so recovered numeral does not establish faithful computation.
best_n_specificity_mean-n32.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

best_n_specificity_mean_then_prune_0.005.finding: The bridge-name anchors and Adwa win are exact text duplicates of an LOO-pruning case, and can be grouped rather than presented as independent qualitative support. The Tugela regression drops the required waterfall name while still mentioning Drakensberg. Chain win retains the wrong equality yielding75; chain anchors remain unrelated arithmetic/final-answer prose.
best_n_specificity_mean_then_prune_0.005.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

A win mentions16 as a final result of another calculation, while an item regression replaces a formerly recovered6 with other numbers. These examples establish selection changes, not faithful latent reasoning.

The DETR anchor remains consistent with Deformable DETR. At DailyDialog p38 the official regression flags a sleep/personal-life span that was already present in the consistent baseline; label sensitivity must remain separate from text deletion. Simula pruning can retain bridge recovery without the optional correct coworker; Enkidu survives with a Gogmagog alias. Arithmetic gains can be isolated correct numerals, while regression 0231 loses its required 2. The child-feeding win retains direction but not all surrounding details; waiter is reduced to an Elias instruction fragment.

In the cataract regression, pruning removes the explicit Tugela mention while Drakensberg/uKhahlamba remains. Chain gain 0341 makes 75 a prioritized numeral while retaining the incompatible 7.5-rounded-up explanation. The comedian retains Marcus-to-heckler direction but adds intoxication absent from the source scene, and the action judge declines humiliation despite accepting comparable silencing language elsewhere. Simula and Enkidu bridge mentions are recovered alongside invented people/aliases. Chain gains can mention 3 while describing reverse operations and other numbers. Babysitter ba improves via child-feeds-babysitter wording; ab regresses to breakfast/dinner and sibling narrative. Specificity does not establish overall faithfulness.

The Wuchale supplement retains the treaty title but loses the required Menelik bridge; target correctness cannot replace the endpoint. Arithmetic anchors retain wrong 14/35 narratives. Chain gain 0341 keeps the false ceil(45/2)=75 equation, and regression 0200 loses the useful 6 in favor of 9/4. Matched retained length is a deletion control, not a guarantee of content preservation.
best_n_specificity_mean_random_delete_ma.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

own_mean_log_likelihood-n8.finding: Only arithmetic is terminal in this pack. Both anchors still miss intermediate 5 or 10 and instead repeat final 14 or unrelated 16/61. Win 0244 prioritizes a 3 but also outputs 12 and 40; regression 0200 replaces the useful 6 with 12/3 and a temperature-doubling story. The changed-no-endpoint item 0206 still passes somewhere in the whole grid while this witness says 44. This evidence concerns own-context likelihood, not the two-control contrast or reconstruction Best-of-32.

consensus_semantic_v5_support0_compatoff.finding: Fixed multihop anchors remain exactly unchanged, and the second arithmetic anchor is unchanged. The first arithmetic anchor repacks repeated 14s, never the required 5. At 0244 the correct 3 already appeared in capped N1; changing the surrounding instruction fragments promotes its official extraction to a hit without newly introducing that number. At 0256 the consensus output drops the useful 7 and keeps generic calculation preambles. The cave regression removes the park name while retaining Son Doong and wrong provinces. Repeated generic instructions can displace sparse useful facts.
consensus_semantic_v5_support0_compatoff.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

consensus_semantic_v5_support0.125_compa.finding: This arm abstains at both multihop anchors and the second arithmetic anchor. The first arithmetic anchor reduces to final-answer 14 rather than intermediate 5. The Simula whole item loses all seven former passing sites; chain 0200 also loses its sole passing site through abstention. The chain win 0396 reduces a mixed 24/32/80 readout to the already present 24; it is a useful filtering result with no valid new derivation. Legionnaires and chain 0227 examples are blank at this witness yet still pass at other sites, so unchanged whole-question endpoints do not imply unchanged information.
consensus_semantic_v5_support0.125_compa.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

consensus_semantic_v5_medium_support0_co.finding: Only arithmetic is terminal in this pack. Regression 0200 keeps the irrelevant becomes-1 fragment while deleting its 6. Win 0392 retains only a table fragment 15|21|16 from a much longer mixed table; the required 15 was already in the baseline, and the numeral-bag judge now selects it. This demonstrates filtering and extraction-context effects, not complete arithmetic explanation recovery.
consensus_semantic_v5_medium_support0_co.limits: Source-only audit of available fixed examples and outcome-selected supplements. Not a prevalence estimate; official scores are unchanged.

random_complete-n1.finding: Fixed anchors are identical to capped N1 in the available families. The accountant ba supplement becomes empty while both full-question endpoints remain passing at four other sites. This is an eligibility/abstention difference in the retained source selector, not evidence of a new random generation or a role-recovery improvement.
